designs.title: 行操作保持同一组解
designs.limits: Exact rational Gauss-Jordan, not continuous row interpolation. Step is discrete and the original matrix remains visible.
designs.keywords: 线性方程组 初等行变换 Gauss Jordan 消元 augmented matrix
designs.summary: 每一步只改写方程，不改变共同的解；橙线右侧是常数项。

designs.title: 主元与自由变量一起决定维数
designs.limits: Coefficient rank excludes RHS. Nullity is a finite example, not a geometric proof for arbitrary fields.
designs.keywords: 秩 零度 基 自由变量 rank nullity kernel
designs.summary: 绿色标出主元，其余未知量可以自由选择。

designs.title: 换一组基，向量没有换
designs.limits: Gold x denotes the same physical vector in both panels; only coordinate grid and contributions change.
designs.keywords: 换基 基 坐标 同一向量 change basis coordinates
designs.summary: 金色向量相同；换一组基，描述它的两个坐标会改变。

designs.title: 两个系数怎样拼出同一向量
designs.limits: Progress reveals head-to-tail basis contributions; it does not move the fixed gold vector or interpolate between bases.
designs.keywords: 基 坐标 线性组合 basis linear combination
designs.summary: 蓝色与紫色分量首尾相接，合成固定的金色向量。

designs.title: 模算术中，哪些元素可以相除
designs.limits: Z/nZ; orange cells mark a*b=0 with both a,b nonzero. Prime/composite distinction is computed exactly. This finite field is not a number field/subfield of C.
designs.keywords: 域 环 零因子 剩余类 modular field ring multiplication table
designs.summary: 乘法表中的单位都有逆元；模数为素数时，每个非零元素都是单位。

designs.title: 两个非零元素也可能乘出零
designs.limits: Z/nZ; orange cells mark a*b=0 with both a,b nonzero. Prime/composite distinction is computed exactly.
designs.keywords: 域 环 零因子 剩余类 modular field ring multiplication table
designs.summary: 如果出现橙格，那里是非零元素的零乘积，不能随意约消。

designs.title: 并排比较两个模运算系统
designs.limits: Both are commutative rings with identity. Only mod 5 is a field; zero divisors are orange.
designs.keywords: 环 域 数域 零因子 modulo prime
designs.summary: 能否对每个非零元素作除法，要看乘法的性质，而不只看加法表。

designs.title: 链长决定幂零变换的结构
designs.limits: Canonical 3+2 chains inferred from nullities; no basis recovery for a general input matrix is claimed.
designs.keywords: 约当 Jordan 链 幂零 最小多项式 循环子空间
designs.summary: 箭头指向变换后的基向量；灰点在这次幂运算中变成 0。

designs.title: 观察各次幂的核怎样逐步扩大
designs.limits: Ranks/nullities checked exactly; table includes N^0=I. The illustrative chain coordinates need not be the input basis.
designs.keywords: 核 核维数 幂零 最小多项式 nilpotency rank Jordan
designs.summary: 核维数的逐次增量告诉我们还剩多少条链，由此读出链的长度。

designs.title: 带余除法写成一组精确系数
designs.limits: Ascending rational coefficients, f=qg+r. This exact example x³−1=(x−1)(x²+x+1) has remainder zero.
designs.keywords: 带余除法 多项式 整除 polynomial division
designs.summary: 每格对应一个幂次；商与余式满足带余除法的恒等关系。

designs.title: 留下的余式次数必须更低
designs.limits: Exact f=(x²+1)x+(x+1), not approximate evaluation at roots.
designs.keywords: 多项式 带余除法 余式 整除 polynomial remainder
designs.summary: 被除式等于除式乘商再加余式，余式的次数更低。

designs.title: 公因式也可以由两个多项式组合得到
designs.limits: u*a+v*b=gcd over Q, monic normalization. Factorization over R or C is a different question.
designs.keywords: 最大公因式 裴蜀 辗转相除 polynomial gcd Bezout
designs.summary: 两个组合系数乘原多项式再相加，得到首一最大公因式。

designs.title: 一条平行线算一个新对象
designs.limits: R²/span(1,1). Moving within a class leaves its quotient coordinate fixed; orthogonal representative is a chosen Euclidean model.
designs.keywords: 商空间 等价关系 商集 陪集 quotient coset
designs.summary: 紫线是子空间，橙线是一个等价类；沿橙线移动不会改变类别。

designs.title: 非齐次解集是齐次解空间的平移
designs.limits: Real 2D example; the orange affine line is the consistent solution set, violet line is the homogeneous kernel. Does not assert arbitrary-field geometric lines.
designs.keywords: 通解 齐次 非齐次 解空间 方程组 affine solution kernel
designs.summary: 紫线是齐次解空间，橙线是把它平移后得到的非齐次解集。

designs.title: 展开的各项既有大小，也有符号
designs.summary: 每项是选中元素乘它的代数余子式；逐项相加得到行列式。
designs.limits: Exact 3×3 row expansion; chosen row/index are replaceable. Bars share a signed scale. This is not a geometric proof of n-dimensional determinants.
designs.keywords: 展开的各项既有大小，也有符号 高等代数 线性代数

designs.title: 对偶基从向量中读出两个坐标
designs.summary: 每条橙线上的函数值相同；两个对偶函数分别读出这组基的两个坐标。
designs.limits: Dual covectors are ROWS of B^-1. Parallel lines illustrate real 2D level sets; no geometric model for arbitrary fields is asserted.
designs.keywords: 对偶基从向量中读出两个坐标 高等代数 线性代数

designs.title: 换坐标后，形状的表达变了，二次型值没变
designs.summary: 左图用旧坐标，右图用新坐标描述同一个点；二次型值保持相同。
designs.limits: C=B^T A B, x=By, not similarity. These panels use different coordinate descriptions. Contour geometry is sampled; black-point values are exact analytic evaluations.
designs.keywords: 换坐标后，形状的表达变了，二次型值没变 高等代数 线性代数

designs.title: 合同变换后，数出正项、负项和零项

props.title: 合同变换后的对角形式

designs.summary: 合同变换后的正项、负项和零项揭示结构；原矩阵的对角线不能单独决定惯性。
designs.limits: Exact rational congruence diagonalization; inertia classification is over R. Counts do not classify quadratic forms over Q, and signs differ over C. No irrational unit normalization claimed.
designs.keywords: 原对角线都是零，也可能有正项和负项 高等代数 线性代数

designs.title: 少一个平方项，就多一个不受约束的方向
designs.summary: 左图的等值线封闭；右图沿竖直方向移动不会改变二次型值。
designs.limits: Real 2D forms x²+y² and x². Coordinate scale is shared. Sampled contours illustrate a fixed example, not arbitrary-field classification.
designs.keywords: 少一个平方项，就多一个不受约束的方向 高等代数 线性代数

designs.title: 同一向量，用斜基与正交基来描述
designs.summary: 金色向量相同；去掉第二条基向量在第一条方向上的分量，就得到正交的两条方向。
designs.limits: Exact rational Gram-Schmidt with the Euclidean metric; no basis path interpolation. Input vectors are rows, displayed basis vectors are columns. Unit normalization is a separate step.

designs.title: 去掉投影，剩下垂直的分量
designs.summary: 蓝色投影与橙色剩余分量首尾相接，合成原向量；剩余分量与第一条方向垂直。
designs.limits: Euclidean two-dimensional example computed by exact Gram-Schmidt. Progress continuously constructs the decomposition; it is not a discrete algorithm or another orthogonalization step.

designs.title: 共轭只把虚部翻到另一侧
designs.summary: 空心点保留原数，实心点表示共轭；蓝色与橙色区分两项分量。
designs.limits: Two independent complex scalar components. Continuous reflection guide changes real coordinates between endpoints; conjugation is not complex-linear. This plane is not an intrinsic picture of C^n.

designs.title: 为什么复内积需要共轭
designs.summary: 比较带共轭与不带共轭的乘积；正定性要求向量与自身的内积是非负实数。
designs.limits: Standard first-slot-linear C^n inner product on a supplied self-pairing, compared with bilinear multiplication. Each plotted mark is one scalar term; positive definiteness is a definition/theorem, not established by this finite example.

designs.title: 酉矩阵需要共轭转置
designs.summary: 并排比较共轭转置与普通转置的乘积实部；酉矩阵的判断使用完整复数结果。
designs.limits: Default diagonal complex phase matrix. Both real/imaginary products are computed exactly; these tensor views show real parts only. Unitary indicator uses both parts and both product orders, never the displayed real matrices alone.

designs.title: 矩阵也能代入多项式
designs.limits: Exact rational evaluation with ascending coefficients. Default p(x)=(x-2)^2 and a 2 by 2 Jordan matrix. Only the complete sum evaluates p(A); intermediate partial sums are separate steps.
designs.keywords: 最小多项式 矩阵多项式 零化多项式 polynomial annihilator Cayley Hamilton
designs.summary: 逐项相加得到矩阵多项式的值；常数项乘单位矩阵。

designs.title: 两个多项式可以次数不同
designs.limits: Exact minimal and characteristic polynomials of the supplied rational matrix; default A=2I in three dimensions. Coefficients appear in ascending powers. Degree alone does not decide diagonalizability; this design computes no eigenvectors.
designs.keywords: 最小多项式 特征多项式 minimal characteristic scalar repeated eigenvalue
designs.summary: 同一矩阵的两个多项式可以次数不同；最小多项式的次数不超过空间维数。

designs.title: 指定一个 λ，观察核与秩
designs.limits: Exact rational matrix and explicitly supplied rational eigenvalue. Shows only this primary component; other eigenvalues need not split over Q. No root finding, complete Jordan form or actual chain basis construction. Shifted powers include0 throughn+1.
designs.keywords: Jordan 广义特征空间 核 维数 幂 秩 rank nullity eigenvalue generalized kernel
designs.summary: 蓝色是核维数，灰色是秩；两者之和是总维数。
